recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-33232; any additional test-case maintenance would belong in the external fhir-test-cases repository rather than this checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-33232 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core clarification asking whether a FHIRPath Patch part for a choice element such as Specimen.processing.time[x] should use the unsuffixed FHIRPath name "time" or the concrete element name "timeDateTime". FHIR-I resolved that the first approach is correct and that the spec and test cases should show it.
initial_application: Git commit ccc2f1bc607deb41208efc01f710a42d5f44c68e applied the request by adding a Choice Elements section and example to source/fhirpatch.html and updating the page's test-case reference to the fhir-test-cases repository.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread and 2021-11-01 FHIR-I minutes both confirm that the correct part name is "time" rather than "timeDateTime". Source/hierarchy.xml includes fhirpatch.html under RESTful API and source/http.html links to it from PATCH guidance, confirming build scope. A same-page extension-example clarification, FHIR-33256, is already separately represented on the combined branch and does not change this choice-element rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined-branch source/fhirpatch.html already explains that choice-element parameter names omit the data type suffix and shows a parsable JSON example using "name": "time" with a valueDateTime; targeted checks found no choice-example part named "timeDateTime".

related_jiras.note: Separate FHIRPath Patch example clarification from the same FHIR-I meeting/page family; already represented on the combined branch and not part of the FHIR-33232 choice-element decision.
